value.rationale: The finite-size global/local energy-noise gap at equal one-particle marginals measures precisely the strength of common reset randomness: a strictly positive exact function for every N>1 that survives at infinite N. The interacting harmonic gas has a full stationary energy distribution and exact time-correlation/averaging law, not an arbitrary small parameter slice. This quantifies non-self-averaging and the distinction between temporal and population averaging and provides a natural, reusable benchmark for globally resetting particle gases.
